answers:
1. Premium unlocks custom programs that your PT can build for you. I don't have a clean list of what free users get beyond the video library, reminders, and progress sharing, so I'd stay with what we know.

2. Honestly I don't have the breakdown by body area or condition in front of me, so I can't say. What I can say for sure is that the library is exactly 312 videos, all filmed by licensed PTs.

3. I don't have the details on that one, like exactly what the PT sees or how they get access. I'd rather not guess and have the copy promise something wrong.

4. I don't know what the progress view looks like, whether that's streaks, pain ratings, or a calendar. Let's keep that line general or skip it until I check.

5. The way I see it, the real problem is patients skipping their exercises more than not having instructions, so that's what Stepwise is built around. One example is Gwen Harper, who used it after a knee replacement and was back to hiking in four months.

<final>
Stepwise: Home Exercise for PT

Recovering at home is hard to stick with. In our experience the bigger problem is skipping exercises, more than not knowing what to do, and Stepwise is built around that. You get clear exercise videos from licensed physical therapists, reminders, and a way to keep your PT up to date.

WHY STEPWISE

• 312 video exercises, all filmed by licensed physical therapists, so you can see proper form for each movement.

• Reminders: set a schedule that fits your day, and we'll nudge you when it's time to exercise.

• Progress sharing: let your physical therapist see how you're doing between visits, so they can adjust your plan.

BUILT FOR REAL RECOVERY

Whether you're healing from surgery, managing an injury, or working on strength and mobility, Stepwise helps you stay consistent. Follow along with each video and check off your exercises as you go.

Gwen Harper used Stepwise after a knee replacement and was back to hiking in four months.

FREE TO START

Download Stepwise and get started at no cost. Premium is $7.99 a month and unlocks custom programs that your PT can build for you.

Subscription details: Premium is billed monthly at $7.99 and renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your Apple ID account settings.

Stepwise is not a substitute for professional medical advice. Talk with your physical therapist or healthcare provider before starting any exercise program.
</final>
